about: Regions where the network builder (scripts/world/build-network.cjs) invents fewer stops. A region is a polygon of [longitude, latitude] points. In a hard region there are no halts on long sections, no spurs out to hamlets, no stops at bare line ends, and a new line only gets a stop at a town or a city, not a village: the stops there are the stations actually mapped, the towns, and the ends of authored routes. Sparse stops are the point of a hard region, where the player has to stock up beforehand.

regions.note: Alaska (with its panhandle) and the Yukon, south to 60 degrees north east of the panhandle, from the continental rail network to the Bering Strait: Ashline's first really hard section (Likea, September 2026).
